notes.chassis: Closed 200x150x100 mm aluminium shell, assumed 2 mm wall. Battery/electronics dimensions and positions are estimates.
notes.links: Solid aluminium capsules/cylinders matching existing equivalent link geometry; actual holes, bearings and fasteners are not individually measured.
notes.tire: Rubber annulus, assumed density 1100 kg/m3 and dry rigid-floor sliding friction 0.8; these are not material measurements.
notes.motors: Hip/knee 0.300 kg each, hub 0.360 kg, retained from confirmed inputs; rotor/stator split 50/50 and equivalent inertias remain estimates.
